name: Ocean Catalogue / CAR FITMENT
heading: Ocean Catalogue / CAR FITMENT
import-help: One Ocean vehicle_id per line, or CSV with vehicle_id, position, side, source, verification_status. Descriptions are not stored as free text.
zero: Fitment: 0 vehicles. Compatibility is UNKNOWN until staff add an explicit vehicle.
empty-search: No matching vehicles in the Ocean catalogue.
ladder-error: Vehicle catalogue could not be loaded. Fitment is not guessed from the product title.
fail-closed: Only explicit product_fitment rows count. Title, tags, vendor, type, collection and description are never used.
oe-warning: Same OE number does not automatically mean same vehicle fitment.
legacy-warning: Legacy Shopify vehicles are reference only and are not Ocean-verified.
